jobs.title: Product Delivery Manager
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

You enjoy shaping the future of product innovation as a core leader, driving value for customers, guiding successful launches, and exceeding expectations. Join our dynamic team and make a meaningful impact by delivering high\-quality products that resonate with clients.  

As a Product Manager in consumer and community banking, you are an integral part of the team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end\-to\-end product life cycle. As a core leader, you are responsible for acting as the voice of the customer and developing profitable products that provide customer value. Utilizing your deep understanding of how to get a product off the ground, you guide the successful launch of products, gather crucial feedback, and ensure top\-tier client experiences. With a strong commitment to scalability, resiliency, and stability, you collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality products that exceed customer expectations.  

**Job responsibilities*** Develops a product strategy and product vision that delivers value to customers
* Manages discovery efforts and market research to uncover customer solutions and integrate them into the product roadmap
* Identifies customer needs and pain points through research and feedback, translating insights into business cases for new features
* Acts as the primary point of contact for stakeholders regarding platform capabilities and roadmap
* Resolves stakeholder issues by providing timely support and ensuring effective communication
* Translates business requirements into clear product specifications and user stories
* Oversees the product lifecycle from ideation to launch and ongoing optimization
* Ensures the platform meets security, compliance, and reliability standards




**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills*** 5\+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in product management or a relevant domain area
* Strong understanding of streaming data technologies such as Apache Kafka, Flink, Trino, Clickhouse Spark Streaming, AWS Kinesis, or Azure Event Hubs
* Experience with cloud platforms, including AWS, and modern data architectures
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams in a matrixed organization
* Ability to translate technical concepts into business value and vice versa
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Demonstrated ability to execute operational management and change readiness activities




**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills*** Demonstrated prior experience working in a highly matrixed, complex organization
* Experience in working with real\-time analytics
* Proficient knowledge of product development in streaming and real\-time platforms
* Experience in product or platform\-wide release management and deployment strategies
* Strong understanding of delivery and a proven track record of implementing continuous improvement processes
* Exposure to cloud technologies

  



  

**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  

  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**  

  

  

Our Consumer \& Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most\-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.  

  

The CCB Data \& Analytics team responsibly leverages data across Chase to build competitive advantages for the businesses while providing value and protection for customers. The team encompasses a variety of disciplines from data governance and strategy to reporting, data science and machine learning. We have a strong partnership with Technology, which provides cutting edge data and analytics infrastructure. The team powers Chase with insights to create the best customer and business outcomes.

jobs.title: Relationship Manager
jobs.description:
### **Job Summary:**


We are seeking a highly motivated and results\-oriented Relationship Manager to join our dynamic team. The Relationship Manager will be responsible for building and nurturing strong, long\-lasting relationships with a portfolio of clients, understanding their financial needs, and providing tailored solutions. This role requires a proactive individual with excellent communication skills, a deep understanding of financial products, and a commitment to delivering exceptional client service.


### **Key Responsibilities:**


* Develop and maintain strong, trust\-based relationships with an assigned portfolio of clients, acting as their primary point of contact.
* Proactively engage with clients to understand their financial goals, challenges, and evolving needs through regular meetings and communication.
* Identify opportunities to cross\-sell and up\-sell relevant financial products and services, including investments, lending, insurance, and wealth management solutions.
* Provide expert advice and guidance on various financial products, explaining complex information clearly and concisely.
* Conduct comprehensive financial reviews for clients, analyzing their current financial situation and recommending appropriate strategies.
* Achieve individual and team sales targets and key performance indicators (KPIs) related to client acquisition, retention, and revenue generation.
* Resolve client inquiries, concerns, and issues efficiently and effectively, escalating complex matters to appropriate internal departments when necessary.
* Collaborate closely with internal specialists (e.g., product specialists, credit analysts, legal) to ensure seamless client service and integrated solutions.

* Ensure all client interactions and transactions comply with regulatory requirements and internal policies and procedures.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date client records and activity logs within the CRM system.
* Prepare and present regular reports on client portfolio performance and sales activities.

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner (B2C)
jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------


At Techdome, Product Ownership goes beyond writing requirements and managing backlogs. We're looking for a B2C **Technical Product Owner** with a strong engineering mindset who can bridge business and technology, own customer\-facing products, and drive product decisions through customer insights, market research, and technical understanding.
You'll work closely with Founders, Engineering, Design, QA, and Business teams to build AI\-first products across Healthcare, FinTech, HRTech, Payments, and Enterprise SaaS. This role requires someone who can take complete ownership of the product lifecycle—from identifying customer problems to delivering scalable solutions that create measurable business impact.**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own product features and modules from discovery, planning, development, and release through continuous improvements.
* Gather, analyze, and prioritize business, customer, and technical requirements.
* Define product vision, roadmap, feature prioritization, and release plans aligned with business objectives.
* Create and maintain Product Backlogs, User Stories, Epics, Acceptance Criteria, PRDs, BRDs, FRDs, and Process Flows.
* Collaborate closely with Engineering teams on solution design, APIs, integrations, technical feasibility, and architecture discussions.
* Work with UX/UI teams to create intuitive user journeys and product experiences.
* Lead Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Release Planning, UAT, Sprint Reviews, and production readiness.
* Ensure product quality, scalability, usability, and customer satisfaction throughout the product lifecycle.
* Leverage AI tools to accelerate product discovery, documentation, competitive research, analysis, and overall productivity.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 3\+ years of experience as a Technical Product Owner, Product Manager, or Technical Business Analyst.
* **Strong experience owning customer\-facing B2C digital products** from ideation to production.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, SDLC, Product Lifecycle Management, Sprint Planning, Backlog Management, and Release Management.
* Hands\-on experience creating PRDs, BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Epics, Acceptance Criteria, Process Flows, and Product Documentation.
* Experience working with JIRA, Confluence, and modern product collaboration tools.
* Good understanding of REST APIs, SQL, Databases, System Integrations, Cloud fundamentals, and Technical Architecture.
* Ability to balance business priorities, customer needs, and technical feasibility while making product decisions.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.

**AI\-First Product Mindset**
-----------------------------


We believe AI is transforming the way products are built.
We're looking for Product Owners who actively leverage AI to improve product strategy, documentation, research, analysis, and decision\-making.
Hands\-on experience with tools such as **ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Perplexity, Notion AI**, or similar AI platforms is highly preferred.
You should be comfortable using AI for:* Requirement analysis and documentation
* Product research and competitive benchmarking
* PRDs, User Stories, and Acceptance Criteria
* Feature ideation and roadmap planning
* Meeting summaries and stakeholder communication
* Workflow automation and productivity enhancement

**What Sets You Apart**
-----------------------


We're looking for Product Owners who don't just manage backlogs they build products.
You should be someone who:* Understands customer pain points and translates them into impactful product features.
* Uses customer feedback, product analytics, and market research to identify opportunities for feature enhancements and innovation.
* Continuously evaluates industry trends, competitor products, and emerging technologies to improve product positioning.
* Thinks strategically about product quality, scalability, adoption, and long\-term customer value.
* Demonstrates strong business acumen, customer empathy, and a proactive ownership mindset.

**Interview Process**
---------------------

* AI Interview (JustInterview.ai)
* Technical \& Functional Discussion
* Assessment Round
* Leadership Discussion

### **Why Join Techdome:**

You'll work on high\-impact, customer\-facing products where your ideas directly influence product direction and business outcomes. If you're passionate about solving real customer problems, leveraging AI to build smarter products, and taking ownership from concept to production, we'd love to have you on our team.

jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in data analytics, Trust and Safety, policy, cybersecurity, business strategy, or related fields.
* 8 years of experience in business strategy, technology research, anti\-abuse, policy, data analytics, cyber\-security, program management or related fields.
* 2 years of experience in people management, leading teams.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in a relevant field.
* Education in, or experience with, machine learning.
* Experience in SQL, building dashboards, data collection/transformation, visualization/dashboards, or experience in a scripting/programming language (e.g. Python).
* Experience working with engineering and product teams to create tools, solutions, or automation to improve user safety.
* Experience working closely with policy teams.
* Ability to translate complex data analyses and emerging abuse trends into actionable business strategies for non\-technical stakeholders and leadership.

**About the job**
-----------------


Trust \& Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know\-how, excellent problem\-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big\-picture thinker and strategic team\-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross\-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed \- with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.



Our team has the critical mission of protecting and respecting Google's users, ensuring online safety in both core and emerging areas. We are at the center of the company\-wide charge to raise the bar on content, including coherent policies and scaled and effective enforcement. We have recently expanded beyond traditional product protections focusing on additional types of abuse: brand safety, controversial content, violent extremism, and political interference. We've advanced user protections, and demonstrated expertise across Google’s growing array of products and services.


In this role, you’ll lead a team, be a thought leader, an excellent operator and will collaborate cross\-functionally. You will bring passion for abuse fighting, focus on putting the user first and lead a high performing team to deliver excellent business results. You will partner with key stakeholders to drive operational performance and lower abuse rates.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Architect the roadmap for global ads defense. Oversee the deployment of analytical frameworks and fraud\-detection methodologies to proactively identify and mitigate content that violates Google Ads policies, staying one step ahead of evolving adversarial tactics.
* Lead strategic cross\-functional initiatives by partnering with executive stakeholders across product, engineering, legal, Public Relation (PR), and public policy to influence long\-term technical roadmaps, roll out policy updates, and ensure safer\-by\-design product features.
* Forge and scale a team of subject matter experts. Advocate a culture of continuous learning and psychological safety, ensuring your team remains resilient and high\-performing while navigating the rapid pace and sensitive nature of global ads content and policies.

jobs.description:
**Overview**  

Commercial Engineering \& AI (CEAI) is the frontier organization for Microsoft’s Commercial Business. We bring together AI‑native engineering, modern platforms, and deep commercial insight to reimagine how work gets done \- at scale and with impact. Our mission is to unlock new ways of operating through intelligent systems while creating the conditions for our teams to do the most meaningful work of their careers.


Customer Success Engineering (CSE) sits within CEAI and builds the AI\-powered platforms, applications, and agents that transform how Microsoft engages, retains, and grows its customers. We operate as a builder organization — we ship, measure real usage, and ship again — pairing deep domain expertise with AI\-assisted development to move from idea to validated value in days rather than quarters using Microsoft technology stack. If you’re excited to build, experiment, and shape the future of commercial execution with AI at the core, we invite you to apply.


We are looking for a Product Manager who is equal parts Product Strategist and hands\-on AI Builder. This is an AI\-native product role: you won’t just define what to build — you’ll use AI to build it. You will set the strategy for the next wave of AI solutions across Microsoft’s Customer Success motion, then rapidly prototype and ship those solutions yourself using AI\-assisted development. This role blends two operating modes. Great candidates are strong in both — and comfortable moving between them daily:

**Product Strategist**

* Owns the multi\-quarter vision and roadmap for AI\-first applications.
* Frames the problem spaces, defines the bets, and sequences the portfolio.
* Translates business goals into measurable product outcomes.
* Aligns leaders, engineering, and design around a shared strategy

**AI Builder**

* Uses AI to build — prototypes and ships applications, agents, and workflows.
* Turns concepts into working demos in days, not quarters.
* Instruments builds with telemetry and evals for AI quality and impact.
* Raises team throughput by applying AI to the product\-development loop.

  

Your work will directly impact multi\-billion\-dollar businesses — fueling revenue growth, sharpening competitive advantage, and optimizing margins. You will also push the latest AI frontiers, including autonomous agentic workflows, deep research and reasoning, and multi\-agent frameworks, while maintaining a relentless focus on high\-quality user experiences — from conversational UX to emerging interaction models across the Microsoft and Copilot ecosystem. Just as importantly, you will use AI to raise the productivity of the entire product organization, establishing the tools, patterns, and evals that let the team ship better products, faster.


This role reflects how product management is evolving in CSE — from requirements author to builder and decision architect. We look for people who consistently demonstrate four shifts:

* **Builder, not just author.** Move beyond specifications to build lightweight business models, decision flows, prototypes, and AI\-assisted experiments that stakeholders can evaluate before engineering commits — using AI\-assisted development to check in production\-ready code for enhancements where it accelerates learning. The goal is to shrink the distance between an idea and validated business value.
* **Systems thinker.** Sees every feature as a node in a larger system rather than a standalone deliverable — thinking end\-to\-end from upstream inputs to downstream impact. Asks "how should the system behave to achieve the outcome?" rather than "what feature should we build?" Uses AI to model systems, expose hidden dependencies, generate edge cases, and evaluate downstream impacts before implementation begins.
* **Intelligent orchestrator.** Treat AI as a reasoning partner that challenges assumptions, proposes alternatives, and automates routine coordination — synthesizing requirements, summarizing decisions, and surfacing risks — so your time is reinvested in ambiguous problems and strategic calls.
* **Decision architect.** Shifts from "is the requirement complete?" to "do we have evidence the solution will achieve the outcome?" Defines evals up front and lets data — not opinion — drive the call, generating evidence through business\-rule simulation, scenario modeling, edge\-case generation, and prototype validation. Correctness before code.

* **Own the vision and roadmap.** Define a multi\-quarter product strategy for AI\-first applications, translating business goals into a coherent portfolio of prioritized scenarios and bets.
* **Envision the next wave.** Lead scenario envisioning and UX \& technical product design for agentic and Copilot\-powered experiences; advise on GTM, adoption, and evolving portfolio strategy.
* **Shape long\-term direction.** Capture, frame, and drive key product insights and ecosystem signals from the market to shape the future of Microsoft AI platform, apps, and toolset.
* Lead prioritization, backlog management, and cross\-team alignment, focusing teams on the highest\-impact work

**Build with AI**

* **Prototype, don’t just spec.** Use AI to rapidly build applications, agents, and workflows with Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and AI\-assisted (low\-code / “vibe coding”) development.

 Story Creation, Product Owner, Product Management, Backlog, Backlog Creation, User Stories, User Experience, Salesforce CRM, Salesforce Administration, Salesforce Flows, Apex (conceptual), API Integrations
 



  





**Experience Range:** 
 5 – 8 years
 



**About the Role:** 




 Product Owner (PO) — Salesforce Domain is a member of the extended Technical Product Management team and a crucial member of the Agile Team. PO owns the Team/Sprint backlog and is the single point of contact for the Dev team and business stakeholders for user story details within the Salesforce ecosystem (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Experience Cloud, and/or platform customizations).
 



  





 PO is responsible for defining and refining user stories for Salesforce configurations, automations, and integrations while prioritizing the Agile Team backlog to streamline execution of product priorities. PO drives story refinement ensuring the Team backlog contains 2 iterations of "ready" work. PO is also the only team member empowered to accept stories as Done.
 



  





**What You Will Do:** 




**Business and Technical Execution:** 



* Build and maintain Agile team backlog aligned to Salesforce platform roadmap and release windows
* Write and refine user stories and acceptance criteria for Salesforce configurations, automations (Flows, Apex), and integrations
* Review and prioritize team backlog for iteration planning; maintain 2 sprints of ready work
* Coordinate dependencies with other Product Owners, Salesforce Architects, Admins, and UI/UX teams
* Accept completed user stories ensuring Definition of Done including Salesforce quality standards (code coverage, governor limits, data compliance)
* Serve as single point of contact for Dev and business teams during sprints
* Create and review L3 diagrams, Swagger/OpenAPI specs for Salesforce REST integrations
* Drive Low\-Level/Domain\-Level Design for Salesforce platform features with Architects
* Review test cases and support QA during system, UAT, and night\-of\-release activities
* Participate in demos, retrospectives, PI planning, and Inspect \& Adapt workshops
* Conduct Platform\-Level Demos with stakeholders showcasing Salesforce features, reports, and dashboards
* Participate in and drive Salesforce release activities including deployment validation and smoke testing
* Run PO sync meetings in larger scaled ARTs and support Technical Product Manager with product vision and roadmap



  





**Relationship \& People, Professional Development:** 



* Build strong working relationships with Salesforce Admins, Architects, Developers, and business stakeholders
* Develop Salesforce platform training materials, release notes, and user manuals for stakeholders
* Contribute to Product Owner Community of Practice (COP) and Scrum Master Community of Practice
* Stay current with Salesforce product releases and incorporate relevant enhancements into the roadmap



  





**What You Will Bring:** 



* Bachelor's Degree (required)
* 4\+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Owner, Business Analyst, or System Analyst roles in Agile software development
* 2\+ years of hands\-on Salesforce platform experience (Admin, configuration, or development context)
* Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud functional processes
* Experience writing user stories for Salesforce features: configurations, Flows, automation, and API integrations
* Strong technical writing, requirements elicitation, and communication skills
* Experience with Agile tools: Jira, Confluence, LucidChart, PlantUML, or VisioFamiliarity with Salesforce data model, object relationships, and SOQL conceptsStrong analytical skills and data\-driven decision\-making
* Scrum Product Owner certification (CSPO) – preferred
* Salesforce Certified Administrator or Platform App Builder – preferred



  





**Must Have Skills:** 



* Relevant Product Management, Product Owner, Business Analyst, or System Analyst experience in an Agile Salesforce product development environment. (Admin experience in salesforce domain)



  





**Nice To Have:** 



* Experience with Salesforce CPQ tool, Marketing Cloud, Experience Cloud, or Einstein Analytics. Familiarity with iPaaS integrations, JSON, API Swaggers, and L1/L2/L3 diagrams in a Salesforce context.

* Proven Agile experience.
* Proven management skills.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Proactive, highly motivated individual with a serious work ethic and goal\-oriented approach.

 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Data Strategy & Acquisition Analyst
jobs.description:
Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  

Die Position
  
  

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
  
  

That’s what makes us Roche.
  
  

As aData Strategy\& Acquisition Analyst based inHyderabad within our Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE), you will build deep expertise in the U.S. healthcare data landscape. You will partner with cross\-functional teams and U.S. stakeholders to evaluate, acquire, and manage data sources, directly shaping how Roche uses data to support commercial and strategic business needs in the U.S. market.
  
  

The Opportunity
  
  

* Dataset Management: Support the evaluation, acquisition, and ongoing management of a broad range of U.S. healthcare datasets, including payer, market access, claims, sales, and competitive intelligence.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate closely with U.S. stakeholders to understand business needs, clarify use cases, and translate complex business questions into clear data requirements, evaluation criteria, and actionable next steps.
* Vendor Evaluation: Evaluate new and existing datasets and vendors (such as IQVIA, Komodo Health, MMIT, and DRG Fingertip) based on business relevance, methodology, quality, limitations, and fit\-for\-purpose application.
* External Partnerships: Partner with external data vendors to understand source methodologies, resolve data\-related queries, and ensure timely access to high\-quality datasets.
* Data Profiling\& Risk Assessment: Apply structured thinking to perform data profiling, data comparison, and validation. Assess potential gaps or risks, challenge assumptions, and provide constructive pushback to ensure alignment with business objectives.
* Documentation: Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation, including dataset summaries, vendor comparisons, and standard operating procedures, to support decision\-making around data investments.


Who You Are
  
  

* Education: You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Healthcare, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
* Experience: You have 2–4 years of relevant experience in pharma, healthcare analytics, life sciences consulting, market research, or commercial analytics.
* Industry Knowledge: You bring a strong foundation in biology, life sciences, and the pharmaceutical industry, possessing a deep understanding of the healthcare ecosystem, the drug development process, and the U.S. commercial/market access landscape.
* Analytical\& Strategic Thinking: You possess strong analytical reasoning and problem\-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail. This enables you to engage stakeholders consultatively, ask strategic questions, and synthesize complex information into clear summaries, actionable recommendations, and “so what?” insights.
* Communication\& Organization: You are an effective communicator with strong organizational and documentation skills. You can manage multiple priorities and are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively across time zones with U.S.\-based teams and external vendors.
* Data Platforms\& Datasets Expertise: You have exposure to external healthcare data platforms and vendors (e.g., MMIT, DRG Fingertip, IQVIA, Komodo Health, Evaluate, Citeline, Spherix Global Insights, Dedham Group, NCCN). You are highly familiar with datasets spanning payer intelligence, sales, claims, real\-world data (RWD), field intelligence, market access, and competitive/market intelligence.
* Technical Skills: You are familiar with (or willing to learn) SQL for basic data extraction, validation, and investigation. Additionally, you have exposure to data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Amazon QuickSight, or similar platforms, along with a basic understanding of data quality concepts.


Wer wir sind
  
  

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100\.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik\-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  

Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.
  
  

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert.

As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world.

**Overview**  

The Windows Enterprise and Security (ENS) team is building a new product and engineering presence in Microsoft's India Development Center (IDC) to deliver the foundational Windows capabilities that enterprises depend on every day.


TPM(Trusted Platform Module) is how millions of Windows users securely store biometric data (like fingerprints or facial recognition) and PINs, providing a secure and convenient way to sign into Windows without having to use a password. TPM technology helps organizations establish a tamper resistant, hardware root of trust that’s at the hear of computing confidential data as well as establishing consistent security access and control.


As the **Principal Product Manager** for TPM/Attestation, you will drive product strategy and execution for the Windows TPM stack in partnership with internal and external partners such as hardware, OEM vendors, Microsoft cloud services like Intune, Azure Attestation and Azure Entra. You will engage directly with enterprise IT admins and IT leadership, and translate customer needs into roadmap and feature decisions spanning the Windows client, services, and cloud control plane.


This is an individual\-contributor role based in Bangalore alongside the broader ENS IDC team.


Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

* Drive the product roadmap and execution for the Windows TPM platform and Azure attestation stack, including the enrollment, credential storage, firmware upgrades, TPM deployment scenarios as Pluton as well as discrete chips.
* Driving relationships, alignment and delivery across internal partners as well as external Hardware/OEM partners.
* Partner with Software Engineering across client, service, and cloud control plane teams to design and ship end\-to\-end enterprise scenarios (onboarding to policy to compliance to remediation).
* Engage directly with enterprise IT admins, IT leadership, and field teams; communicate the Windows manageability value proposition (security, compliance, cost reduction, modern management) and run customer feedback loops into product requirements.
Drive continuous improvement of platform fundamentals \- security, performance, automation, quality, and validation * \- including investments that improve Intune service scalability.
* Define success criteria, ship plans, and data\-informed metrics (policy success rates, deployment friction, usage) for cross\-functional projects, and ensure alignment across organizations.
Partner with support, field, and engineering teams on customer issues and feedback, and represent Windows manageability in cross\-team and partner forums.  
*

* Bachelor's Degree AND 8\+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development.
	+ OR equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years of experience managing cross\-functional and/or cross\-team projects.
* Experience defining and shipping enterprise software, manageability, device management, or platform capabilities.

Deep Technical Foundation

* Solid grounding in Windows OS architecture \+ security model.

* TPM, secure boot, attestation, measured boot.
* Device identity, key protection, root of trust.

jobs.title: Data & AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Data \& AI Product Manager** 




  





 Job Location:
 



  





**The role** 




 This role exists at the intersection of a technically complex AI system and a commercial market that is still learning what it will pay for. As Data and AI Product Manager you will define what Driivz's data and AI capabilities look like as products that operators buy \-\- the packaging, the pricing logic, the proof\-of\-value framework, and the commercial conversation that converts a pilot into a contract.
 



  





 You are not a scrum master and you are not a backlog prioritiser. You are the person who understands what operators will pay for before the team builds it, designs the commercial model that makes the product a business, and manages the pilot operators whose experience generates the proof points that make the next sale possible. You work from India but you spend significant time in commercial conversations with operators across multiple geographies.
 



  





**What you will own** 




**Product and commercial** 



* AI product scope and packaging: what gets built into a discrete product that operators pay for, in what tiers, at what price points
* Commercial model design: the pricing logic that connects the value Driivz generates for operators to a fee structure that is fair, credible, and scalable
* Proof\-of\-value framework: the structure of pilot periods including baseline measurement, tracked metrics, and conversion logic \-\- the 90\-day pilot must make the commercial decision obvious, not require a separate sales effort
* Guardrail framework: translating operator preferences for AI decision boundaries into documented product configuration requirements for the engineering team



  





**Customer and market** 



* Pilot operator management: running the proof periods of the first 3 to 5 operator pilots from connection to contract
* Operator discovery: 5 or more structured discovery conversations per quarter with operator ops directors and commercial leadership \-\- understanding what they will pay for before building it
* GTM with CS and commercial: translating AI system capabilities into the language and framing that closes a conversation with a CFO or COO
* External operator pipeline: identifying and engaging operators outside Driivz's existing customer base who are candidates for standalone AI product adoption



  





  





**What we are looking for** 




**Non\-negotiable** 



* You have taken a data or AI product to market \-\- not internal tooling, not a feature within a larger product, but a discrete product that external customers evaluated, negotiated, and paid for.
* You have designed a commercial model for a product where value is variable and outcome\-linked. You understand the difference between value\-based pricing and cost\-plus pricing and can explain when each is appropriate.
* You have run commercial discovery conversations at VP or C\-suite level \-\- not just with product users or technical stakeholders. You understand how a CFO evaluates a data product differently from how an ops director does.
* You can build a financial case from operational data. The commercial conversation for this product requires translating system performance metrics into an operator P\&L impact that a CFO will accept.



  





**Strong signal** 



* EV, energy, smart grid, infrastructure, or industrial IoT sector product experience
* SLA\-based or outcome\-linked commercial model experience: contracts where payment depends on measured performance
* Cross\-geography commercial experience: operator conversations spanning different regulatory environments and commercial cultures
* Technical credibility: able to explain what the AI system does without misrepresenting it \-\- CPOs ask hard questions and will not sign contracts with someone who does not understand the product
* Proof period design: has structured a time\-limited pilot that produced a clear, data\-backed commercial decision at the end



  





**This role is not right for you if** 



* You have only managed internal product roadmaps or feature backlogs. This role requires commercial ownership \-\- pricing decisions, contract terms, and the revenue that comes from signed contracts.
* You have not had commercial conversations with CFO or COO\-level buyers. The product conversation for AI systems that affect operational costs and revenues happens at a different level than typical product discovery.
* You cannot explain the difference between a managed fee and a performance\-based commercial model, or when each is the right choice for an operator in a specific situation.

 Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full\-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business \- without vendor lock\-in or costly implementation cycles.
   

  

 At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context\-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities \- AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real\-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.
   

  

 Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025\), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026\), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50\+ industries and 1,000\+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI\-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.
   

  

 If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more \- deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Glean is seeking a Product Manager who will play a pivotal role in realizing our vision: to become the most powerful AI assistant, delivering enterprise\-contextualized intelligence, actioning, and support seamlessly across every workflow and environment. We're building best\-in\-class products that not only help users find, curate, share, and manage knowledge, but also proactively assist and take action—right where work happens. Join us as we shape the future of work by embedding Glean’s AI\-driven capabilities into every corner of the modern enterprise experience.
   

  

 We’re currently a very lean product team, so you’ll have an outsized role in shaping both the product roadmap and the product team itself. You’ll collaborate closely with our stellar Design, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Success partners to understand our customers and build category\-defining tools. You’ll wear many hats and gain both breadth and depth of experience.
   

  

**You Will**
* Spend a lot of time with our customers to deeply understand their knowledge needs
* Develop key parts of our product roadmap, marrying customers’ needs with our product vision
* Empower your team by giving context, setting direction, and building alignment
* Drive customer\-focused decisions, clear prioritization, and efficient execution
* Coordinate cross\-functionally with with leadership, go\-to\-market teams, and other key stakeholders across the company
* Build processes that will scale as our team and company go through rapid growth


**About You**
* You have 5\+ years of experience in product management at SaaS companies, primarily serving large enterprises with responsibilities spanning customer\-facing surfaces and features as well as internal capabilities and services.
* You have a strong technical background and experience with API\-first products, integration paths, and 3rd party product partnerships.
* You are an excellent written and verbal communicator.
* You have a proven track record of taking ownership, taking initiative, and delivering results.
* You collaborate effectively with cross\-functional partners.
* You have a learning and growth mindset.
* You are mission\-first and understand that your success is measured by your product and team’s success.
* You are an early adopter in building with or adopting AI for your own product craft and you are excited about helping customers accelerate their own AI adoption journey.


**Location:**
* This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Bangalore office)


**Compensation \& Benefits**
 Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.
   

  

 We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.
   

  

**AI\-First Mindset At Glean**
 At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work.
 **As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI\-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role.** 
 Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.

Introduction
   

  

**Job Title:**
 Product Manager
   

  

**Overview:**
 SymphonyAI is at the forefront of innovation, leveraging cutting\-edge artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies to transform industries and drive business growth. As a global leader in AI\-powered solutions, we empower organizations to harness the full potential of data\-driven insights. SymphonyAI enterprise applications rapidly deliver transformative business value across retail, CPG, financial services, manufacturing, media, Enterprise IT (SymphonyAI Summit), and the public sector.
   

  

 SymphonyAI Industrial is seeking a Product Manager with 6\-8 years of experience to help drive the roadmap and execution for the IRIS Foundry platform. This role focuses on building and enhancing industrial AI and data platform capabilities that enable predictive maintenance, reliability, operational intelligence, and industrial analytics solutions across manufacturing, energy, utilities, mining, and process industries. The ideal candidate should have strong product management fundamentals, experience working with enterprise SaaS or platform products, and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, UX, data science, and customer\-facing teams.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Responsibilities:**
* Contribute to the product vision and roadmap for the IRIS Foundry platform
* Work with senior product leaders, customers, and engineering teams to identify and prioritize platform capabilities
* Support roadmap planning and release prioritization based on business impact and customer value
* Define detailed product requirements, user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria
* Partner with engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle
* Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release planning
* Track feature delivery, dependencies, risks, and product quality metrics
* Collaborate with architects and engineers to ensure scalable and user\-centric platform design
* Work closely with Engineering, UX/UI, Data Science, Customer Engagement, and Professional Services teams to ensure successful feature delivery and customer adoption


**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
* 6\-8 years of product management experience in enterprise software, SaaS platforms, industrial technology, or AI\-driven products
* Proven expertise as a Product Manager, ideally in managing enterprise SaaS or platform products
* Strong understanding of Agile product development methodologies
* Ability to write clear product requirements and user stories
* Good prioritization, analytical, and problem\-solving skills
* Strong understanding of cloud\-based platforms, APIs and integrations, data platforms and analytics, AI/ML\-driven applications, and enterprise software architecture
* Experience working with Agile/Scrum teams in fast\-paced product organizations
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to work effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional coordination capabilities
* Customer\-focused mindset with strong attention to detail


**Preferred Skills \& Qualifications:**
* Prior experience in industrial software, manufacturing technology, or IoT platforms
* Exposure to industrial domain AI applications, such as Asset Performance Management (APM), manufacturing operations, industrial IoT, and reliability/maintenance systems


**Diversity \& Inclusion Statement:**
 We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.
   

  

**About Us**
 SymphonyAI is building the leading enterprise AI SaaS company for digital transformation across the most critical and resilient growth industries, including retail, consumer packaged goods, financial crime prevention, manufacturing, media, and IT service management. Since its founding in 2017, SymphonyAI today serves 1500\+ Enterprise customers globally and has grown to 3,000 talented leaders, data scientists, and other professionals across over 30 countries.

 At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take\-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175\+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.
   

  

 From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind\-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. Fan\-favorites and latest hits include FarmVille™, Words With Friends™, Zynga Poker™, Game of Thrones Slots Casino™, Wizard of Oz Slots™, Hit it Rich! Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.
   

  

 Join us and be part of the play!
   

  

**Position Overview**
 Zynga India is looking for an experienced Product Manager with demonstrated success in mobile and/or consumer products to join the team and help connect the world through PLAY.
   

  

 As a hardworking and ambitious product leader, you will innovate and execute on product initiatives that will bring surprise and delight to our players while delivering business value to the company.

The Product Manager will have a consistent record of owning and delivering experiences to customers that raise\-the\-bar from an innovation, usability, and design perspective. You will need to thrive and deliver results in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.

* Responsible for the full product/game lifecycle, from writing specifications, working across multi\-disciplinary teams: design, art, and engineering to launch core features within our existing and new games!
* Exhibit sound product discernment, ability to formulate product strategy and present clear measurable objectives that will lead to achieving our business goals.
* Expected to provide valuable input into business cases based on in\-depth data analysis and demonstrate how that analysis impacts key product metrics.
* Run prioritization and trade\-offs among customer experience, technical constraints and business drivers.
* Expected to develop a deep understanding of our users: their problems, their needs, their desires


**What You Bring**
* 4\+ years of experience in product management in consumer/mobile or game development is preferred but not required
* Focus on outcomes with shown experience making product teams successful
* Ability to communicate across diverse cultures, languages, work styles, and personalities
* Ability to create wire\-frames, product specifications and white papers
* Strong project management skills and ability to present work to executive staff
* Willingness to roll up your sleeves and do whatever it takes to help your team win
* Extraordinary data analysis skills
* Experience with multivariate testing and experimentation
* Strong passion for games and creating fun, compelling and addictive user experiences
* Outstanding written/oral, organizational, analytical abilities, and attention to detail
* You be a self\-starter, a teammate and driven
* Previous start\-up, social networking and/or consulting experience is a strong plus.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Enterprise Data Products (HR & Legal)
jobs.description:
**Who are we?**
 Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
   

  

 A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
   

  

 A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We're building HR and Legal data products that power workforce planning, talent strategy, compliance, and risk management across the enterprise. These products unify data from core systems (HRIS/HCM, ATS, contract lifecycle, and compliance tooling) and are delivered through a unified enterprise analytics and intelligence platform—a trusted single source of reference that exposes insight through APIs, semantic models, dashboards, and conversational and agentic AI experiences.
   

  

 As Product Manager, you'll help drive the data \& analytics product strategy and roadmap for our Corporate Functions (HR and Legal). You'll partner closely with stakeholders to understand their strategic priorities, operating rhythms (talent review cycles, workforce planning cadence, compliance calendars, contract renewals), and pain points—fragmented data, manual reporting, limited scenario planning, and governance gaps—and translate them into high\-impact, AI\-enabled data products that increase insight precision, automate reporting, and elevate HR and Legal as strategic advisors to the business.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner \& advise: Build trusted relationships with HR and Legal stakeholders by understanding their objectives, operating cadence, and core processes; translate pain points (attrition risk, headcount reconciliation, skills and talent gaps, DEI reporting, contract bottlenecks, compliance governance) into data product solutions. Manage stakeholder expectations within and across functions
* Shape strategy \& roadmap: Support development of the product strategy and an ROI\-informed roadmap, balancing quick\-win delivery with foundational platform efforts
* Build data products: Contribute to function\-grade semantic models (employee, talent, headcount, contract, compliance) that integrate with the enterprise platform, its model store, and query APIs. Help productize analytics and AI/ML services—workforce forecasting, talent dashboards, compliance reporting packs, conversational insights, governance\-enabled data catalogs—while upholding platform principles: system of reference (not system of record), domain data ownership, and full lineage, provenance, and auditability
* Analyze the market: Research industry practices, competitors, and verticals; report on emerging HR and Legal analytics and AI trends (predictive attrition modeling, skills intelligence, contract analytics, compliance automation). Introduce best\-in\-class external practices and governance frameworks (GDPR, data privacy, records compliance)
* Develop business cases: Collaborate on—and may create—financial business models; conduct business opportunity reviews with senior team members
* Measure success: Define metrics that inform product success and drive user experience improvements (adoption, reporting cycle\-time reduction, forecast accuracy, model quality, automation ROI)
* Collaborate cross\-functionally: Work closely with data platform, data science, AI/ML, and engineering teams; support backlog refinement, test case definition and UAT, and design product training curriculum


**Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience preferred, ideally with exposure to HR and/or Legal data products
* Bachelor's degree preferred, ideally in Statistics, Data Science, Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field
* Familiarity with modern enterprise data platforms, semantic/data modeling, APIs, and AI/ML concepts; experience delivering products on an analytics/intelligence platform is a strong plus
* Understanding of data governance principles—lineage, provenance, auditability, and domain data ownership
* Knowledge of HR and/or Legal concepts (workforce planning, talent management, people analytics, compliance, data privacy, contract lifecycle management) is a strong plus
* Excellent communicator who can simplify the complex and build trusted relationships with business stakeholders
* Ability to work across HR, Legal, IT, Engineering, Data Science, and AI/ML teams
* Bias for action, ownership, and the ability to break down complex problems, drive alignment, and remain decisive

 We are seeking experienced Product Owners to help deliver on our product objectives and roadmaps. Product Owners are responsible for delivering product outcomes and functionality that meet customer and user needs. They translate product vision and insights into prioritized features and user stories, developed by their agile team of 8–10 members.
   

  

 This role collaborates with Candescent clients and Product Managers to identify and prioritize requirements for enhancements to the Banking Platform. Product Owners also work with the Product Advisory Council, participating in user group discussions and presenting both strategic and tactical functionality. Additional responsibilities include release planning, product roadmap maintenance, and backlog grooming for assigned Candescent Banking Services initiatives.
   

  

**Key Areas of Responsibility**
* Lead efforts to define specific functions, integration requirements, user experiences, and deployment strategies for delivery to both the company and market
* Develop, shape, and refine user stories, problem statements, and acceptance criteria to ensure efficient and effective team consumption
* Collaborate with the broader product organization to ensure integration across all Candescent Digital Banking Technology products
* Work closely with the development team to ensure that delivered products meet specified requirements and are delivered on time and within budget
* Drive understanding of the work to be completed by the development team, supporting effective sprint sequencing and incremental delivery
* Participate actively in scrum ceremonies such as sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, daily stand\-ups, and demos
* Maintain functional quality by setting and evaluating expectations and acceptance criteria
* Present and train internal customers on new platform features and services released in each version
* Prepare explanatory documentation for customers on existing and new platform functionality

**Product P\&L and Pricing**

**Product Strategy, Vision, and Planning**

**Customer Experience Research, Insights, And Execution**

**Product Design and Development**
* Participate in PI (Program Increment) planning to prioritize the roadmap and inform team backlogs

jobs.title: Group Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us** 




 Scapia! A credit card that’s out there to make travel happen for people, by converting their everyday expenses into travel experiences. We’re a bunch of passionate people who work together, brainstorm, and debate with each other, and don’t stop until we’re proud of our work. Customer delight tops everything else! We’ve worked hard to create an environment of honesty and passion that sets everyone up for success.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for Group Product Manager to Group Product Manager to lead our Storefront, Recommendations \& CRM
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




 Build the systems that recognize who a user is and serve them something relevant, on the surfaces that matter, through the channels where they are present.
 



  





 This role owns four connected goals:
 



  





 Maximize LTV through personalized discovery and cross\-sell
 



 Build the recommendations platform that powers contextual discovery across homepage, inner pages, order confirmation, and coin pages. The job is to move users through activation, habit formation, retention, and monetization, not just show them more inventory.
 



  





 Deliver a best\-in\-class app and web experience
 



 Reduce performance and reliability friction across the journey: app size, app start time, crash\-free rate, app load time, app\-open\-to\-home latency, and web metrics (FCP, LCP, landing page optimization). This is the foundation the recommendations platform sits on.
 



  





 Build a unified view of customer intent
 



 Combine behavioral and declared signals into a single, coherent picture of what each user wants and when. This powers personalization today and future monetization surfaces including ads, where Scapia's travel\-financial identity graph becomes something advertisers pay to reach.
 



  





 Own communication as a product surface
 



 Build in\-app notifications and CRM systems that optimize for reach and open rate without degrading user trust. Scapia's new and existing cohorts each need a different message, cadence and channel. Getting it right is one of the highest\-leverage, lowest\-cost retention levers available.
 



  





**What You’ll Own** 



* The recommendations platform roadmap, surfaces, user signals, context and supply signals that go into the models
* App performance and web performance workstreams, partnering closely with platform and infra engineering
* The customer data and signals strategy that unifies behavioral and declared intent
* CRM and in\-app notification systems, including segmentation logic and trust guardrails



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 7\+ years in product management, with at least 2\-3 years owning a recommendations, personalization, or lifecycle marketing system at meaningful scale
* Demonstrated ability to reason about cohorts, not averages: you segment users by behavior and design differently for each segment rather than shipping one experience for everyone
* Working fluency with app performance metrics (crash\-free rate, cold start time) and web performance metrics (Core Web Vitals), even if you haven't personally owned an infra roadmap
* Experience partnering with data science or ML teams on signal design, feature stores, or recommendation models
* A track record of building CRM or notification systems that grew engagement without eroding trust or triggering fatigue/opt\-outs
* Comfort managing PMs and running a multi\-workstream charter, not just a single feature line
* Financial services, travel, or loyalty/rewards experience is a plus, not a requirement

5\. Monitor \& report the health of the change and escalate when needed

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

Role Key Objective
  
To support and maintain the technology platforms and data ecosystems that enable efficient, accurate, and compliant service delivery across regional operations.
  
  

Job Summary
  
The Technology Business Analyst is responsible for the day\-to\-day administration, support, and continuous improvement of the digital platforms and workflows underpinning regional service delivery. Acting as the primary point of contact for platform\-related issues, the Technology Business Analyst ensures system integrity, data quality, and user access are maintained to the highest standard. They partner with operational teams across functions to resolve technical issues, manage approval workflows, and govern user data — ensuring platforms remain reliable, compliant, and fit for purpose at all times.
  
  

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  
Systems Analysis \& Support
  
* Perform daily preventative maintenance monitoring across all active digital trackers and platforms
* Triage and resolve user\-submitted support tickets across all supported processes and work applications


Data Quality Management
  
* Process data correction requests across all active trackers and submission workflows
* Maintain and update reference data and dropdown configurations across platforms to reflect current operational requirements


Licenses and Access Management Support
  
* Process user access and platform license requests, ensuring timely and accurate provisioning
* Maintain records of all access grants and license allocations in line with governance requirements


Skills
  
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to diagnose technical and data\-related issues across complex digital workflows
* Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple concurrent requests and prioritise effectively in a fast\-paced environment
* Excellent attention to detail, particularly in data validation, user record management, and access provisioning
* Clear and professional communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to support non\-technical users with confidence
* Proactive and self\-directed — able to identify issues independently and take corrective action without waiting for escalation
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365 tools including Excel, Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, and MS Lists
* Proficiency in Smartsheet is considered a strong advantage


Experience
  
* Prior experience in a technical support, systems administration, or business analyst role
* Experience working with global or cross\-regional teams in a multicultural environment


Qualifications

**Job Description: Business Analyst / Senior Business Analyst (FS)** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 We are building a next\-generation product engineering organization where we are looking for Business Analysts who will transform business problems, customer needs, and market opportunities into well\-defined product capabilities that engineering teams can build with confidence.
 



  





 The Business Analyst will combine
 **strong business analysis skills, product thinking, domain modelling, systems thinking,** 
 and AI\-assisted analysis to discover requirements, define product behavior, and enable rapid product delivery.
 



 This role focuses on
 **understanding customer journeys, analyzing complex business domains, documenting functional and non\-functional requirements, modelling business processes, and collaborating across product, engineering, architecture, and AI teams.** 
 We are looking for analysts who can effectively use AI as a force multiplier to accelerate research, documentation, requirement analysis, and product discovery while ensuring business accuracy and completeness.
 



  





**Experience level** 
 : 5 to 10 years
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Product Discovery:** 



* Work closely with Product Managers, customers, domain experts, and engineering teams to discover business problems and identify product opportunities.
* Conduct workshops, stakeholder interviews, and collaborative discovery sessions.
* Translate customer needs into clearly defined product capabilities and solution requirements.



  





**Business Analysis:** 



* Analyze complex business processes and identify opportunities for automation, optimization, and digital transformation.
* Define functional and non\-functional requirements for product capabilities.
* Document business rules, workflows, decision logic, user journeys, and system interactions.
* Maintain complete traceability from business objectives through implementation.



  





**Domain Modelling \& Product Design:** 



* Develop and maintain business domain models that accurately represent customer processes, products, entities, relationships, and business events.
* Bring the perspective of FS centric regulatory requirements, financial security context to product design.
* Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to ensure domain models align with system architecture and product design.
* Continuously refine domain models as product capabilities evolve.



  





**Requirements Engineering:** 



* Prepare high\-quality: User Stories, Epics, Features, Acceptance Criteria, Business Rules, Functional Specifications, Process Flows, Decision Models
* Ensure requirements are clear, testable, implementable, and aligned with business objectives.



  





**Cross\-functional Collaboration:** 



* Work closely with Product Managers, Architects, UX Designers, Engineers, Data Scientists, QA Engineers, and DevOps teams throughout the product lifecycle.
* Clarify business requirements during development and testing.
* Support product validation and customer acceptance activities.



  





**AI\-Augmented Business Analysis:** 



* Use AI\-powered tools to accelerate market research, business analysis, requirement documentation, user story creation, process modelling, and product documentation.
* Validate AI\-generated outputs for business correctness, completeness, consistency, and regulatory compliance.
* Apply AI responsibly while maintaining domain expertise and analytical rigor.



  





**Product Validation:** 



* Participate in product demonstrations, user acceptance testing, and solution validation.
* Verify implemented functionality against business requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Work with QA teams to ensure comprehensive business test coverage.
* Gather customer feedback and continuously improve product capabilities.



  





**Required Skills** 



* Strong experience in Business Analysis within software product development environments.
* **Financial Services Domain Knowledge**
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience of creating business requirements, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process documentation.
* Strong understanding of Agile product development methodologies.
* Experience with business process modelling and workflow analysis.
* Familiarity with modern product management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Miro, Figma, or similar platforms.
* Experience using AI\-powered tools to improve business analysis, documentation, and research productivity.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.



  





**Desired Skills** 



* Product Thinking, Domain\-Driven Design (DDD)
* Business Process Management (BPM)
* Customer Journey Mapping
* AI\-assisted Product Discovery
* Design Thinking
* Systems Thinking



  





**What Success Looks Like in This Role** 




 Within the first year, you will:
 


* Successfully translate complex customer problems into clear, implementable product requirements.
* Develop reusable business domain models that improve product quality and engineering efficiency.
* Improve requirement quality, reducing ambiguity and downstream rework.
* Enable engineering teams to deliver features faster through well\-defined user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Be the custodian for the product backlog in the respective product area.
* Help establish AI\-assisted business analysis practices that improve productivity while maintaining business accuracy.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
****Role Overview****
 We are seeking a high\-impact Business Analyst to bridge data, client expectations, and business outcomes. This role involves deep engagement with client data, generating actionable insights, and driving value through structured reporting, stakeholder communication, and analytical storytelling.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine strong analytical capabilities with client\-facing skills, enabling them to translate raw data into strategic recommendations, ensure delivery excellence, and proactively identify growth and risk mitigation opportunities.
   

  

 Location : Mumbai(BKC), Delhi(NCR), Guragon
   

  

 Work Mode : Remote
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
****1\. Data Understanding \& Analysis****
* Analyze client datasets (travel, finance, GST, or operational data) to identify patterns, discrepancies, and opportunities.
* Develop structured analytical frameworks to derive meaningful insights aligned with client objectives.
* Ensure high data quality through validation, reconciliation, and continuous monitoring.


****2\. Dashboarding \& Reporting****
* Design and develop interactive dashboards using tools such as Zoho Analytics, Power BI, or similar BI platforms .
* Create standardized and client\-specific reports to track key performance metrics.
* Enable self\-serve analytics for internal stakeholders (Key Account Managers, leadership teams).


****3\. Client Communication \& Query Resolution****
* Act as the primary point of contact for billing, reporting, and data\-related queries .
* Provide timely and accurate responses to client concerns, ensuring high satisfaction levels.
* Simplify complex data insights into clear, client\-friendly narratives.


****4\. Business Reviews (WBRs \& QBRs)****
* Lead preparation and execution of Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs) and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) .
* Present insights, performance metrics, challenges, and opportunities to client stakeholders.
* Collaborate with internal teams to align on action items and strategic priorities.


****5\. Process Mapping \& Documentation****
* Create detailed As\-Is process documentation for client workflows.
* Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities within existing processes.
* Support the design of scalable and standardized operating models.


****6\. Insight Generation \& Revenue Enablement****
* Identify trends and patterns in data to uncover new business opportunities and sales pipelines .
* Partner with Sales and Account Management teams to provide data\-backed recommendations for upselling/cross\-selling.
* Translate insights into measurable business impact.


****7\. Risk Management \& Expectation Alignment****
* Continuously evaluate client expectations vs. actual delivery to identify potential risks.
* Proactively flag gaps and recommend corrective actions to prevent escalations.
* Ensure alignment across stakeholders on deliverables, timelines, and outcomes.


****8\. Internal Enablement \& Dashboarding****
* Create internal dashboards for Key Account Managers (KAMs) to track performance and drive effective QBRs.
* Standardize reporting formats and templates across clients.
* Enable data\-driven decision\-making within internal teams.


**Requirements** 
****Education****
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Analytics, or related field
* MBA or equivalent is a plus


**Experience**
* 2–6 years in Business Analysis, Consulting, Analytics, or Client\-Facing roles
* Experience in data\-heavy environments (finance, SaaS, travel, GST, or operations) preferred


****Technical Skills****
* Strong proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets
* Hands\-on experience with BI tools (Zoho Analytics, Power BI, Tableau, etc.)
* Basic understanding of data structures, SQL (preferred but not mandatory)


****Core Competencies****
* Analytical thinking and problem\-solving
* Stakeholder management and client communication
* Structured thinking and documentation skills
* Ability to translate data into actionable insights
* Strong ownership and accountability


**Benefits**
* Opportunity to work at the intersection of data, consulting, and client strategy
* High ownership and visibility with leadership and clients
* Fast\-paced environment with significant learning and growth potential

We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education \& Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration.
   

  

 ,

**Locatio**

 t:
